title: source_card component
description: Resolved payload for the `source_card` catalogue member: which of the envelope's sources this card presents, named in `description.sources` on a payload with a description and in `provenance.sources` otherwise. Carries no duplicated source objects; the envelope stays the single source of truth and this component is the presentation instruction.

source_ref.description: the source a value came from: on a payload with a `description`, the `ref` of an entry in `description.sources` (a provenance dcid such as `provenance/OECDCreditorReportingSystem`); otherwise the `src_` id of an entry in `provenance.sources`, which the envelope schema holds to the `src_` pattern
